subject.title: fix(media): suppress local whisper progress transcripts

question: Should OpenClaw accept the compatibility-sensitive no-stdout-fallback behavior for deterministic CLI STT txt-output paths after the branch is refreshed?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported transcript leak, but it intentionally changes upgrade-visible fallback behavior for existing CLI audio configurations that specify deterministic file outputs.

options.title: Accept after refresh
options.body: Refresh the branch, clear or baseline QA Smoke, and land the authoritative file-output behavior as the media runner contract.

options.title: Add compatibility mode
options.body: Require a narrow explicit compatibility path if maintainers want existing file-output configurations to keep stdout fallback behavior.

options.title: Pause media contract
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a media owner chooses between fail-closed file output and configurable stdout fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept after refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, clear or baseline QA Smoke, and land the authoritative file-output behavior as the media runner contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most relevant media runner helper and parakeet file-output history found in git history.
